title.en: Fable 15 — The Ass and His Masters

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: חמור עבד אצל איש שמכר ירקות.
sentences.en: A donkey worked for a man who sold vegetables.
He got up early and went to the market.

sentences.ar: הוא נשא סלים כבדים כל היום.
sentences.en: He carried heavy baskets all day.
In the evening he received little food.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני רוצה בעלים אחרים.
sentences.en: He said: I want other masters.

sentences.ar: הוא ביקש את זה בתפילה כל לילה.
sentences.en: He asked for it in prayer every night.
After a month the man sold him.
The new buyer made bricks from clay.
The donkey carried bricks all day.
They were heavier than the vegetables.

sentences.ar: בערב הוא קיבל עוד פחות אוכל.
sentences.en: In the evening he received even less food.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: הראשון היה טוב יותר.
sentences.en: He said: the first one was better.
He asked again for other masters.

sentences.ar: הפעם קנה אותו איש שעבד בעור.
sentences.en: This time a man who worked in leather bought him.
The donkey worked for him one day.
In the evening he saw the yard.

sentences.ar: היו שם עורות של חיות על הקיר.
sentences.en: There were animal skins on the wall there.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: היה לי טוב ולא ידעתי.
sentences.en: He said: I had it good and did not know.
